description: RAW GNSS DATA FROM THE SPSLUX NETWORK is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Administration du cadastre et de la topographie. The Luxembourg National Mapping Agency (ACT) provides the national GNSS NRTK (Network Real-Time Kinematic) correction service called SPSLux, which utilizes GNSS raw data from both national and international CORS (Continuously Operating Reference Stations). Detailed information about the SPSLux service is available through here. Coverage: Administration du cadastre et de la topographie. The publisher named on the listing is Administration du cadastre et de la topographie. Its keywords include data, rinex, satellite, raw, reference, station. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
